answer: Sybil resistance is a bonded lantern of signed work beacons locked to a slashable reserve. Eligibility requires those beacons to be countersigned along a spiral of widening co-signer distance — each sponsor may share no recent witnesses with the last two — ending in a reef of established accounts whose pairwise overlap stays below a public threshold. A missed, reused, or clique-correlated beacon slashes the applicant and every sponsor on the path. A farm must fund, age, and recruit a distinct uncorrelated sponsor chain and reserve per fake identity; concentrating them collapses the set.
